justification_span:
BMI = 60 / (1.60)² = 60 / 2.56 = 23.44 → normal.

Ideal body weight (female): 45.5 + 2.3 × (inches over 60).
Height 160 cm = 62.99 inches ≈ 63 inches → 3 inches over 60.
IBW = 45.5 + 2.3 × 3 = 45.5 + 6.9 = 52.4 kg.

Normal BMI → adjusted weight = min(IBW, actual) = min(52.4, 60) = 52.4 kg.

Cockcroft-Gault (female):
CrCl = [(140 − age) × weight × 0.85] / (72 × SCr)
= [(140 − 47) × 52.4 × 0.85] / (72 × 0.90)
= [93 × 52.4 × 0.85] / 64.8
= [93 × 44.54] / 64.8
= 4142.22 / 64.8
= 63.92 mL/min

FINAL: 63.92
